answer: Each claimant crawls 38 meters into the public karst gallery, catches one ceiling drip in a 12 ml vial at 05:17 local, and records a 45-second zephyr at the mouth with a hand anemometer whose serial is etched on the cap. The south cargo wharf clerk weighs the vial to 0.1 g, hashes the wind log, and issues one seat token. A second vial from the same key is refused if the drip interval has not advanced by one 9-minute crawl or the serial is reused. A dry ceiling or calm mouth defers the seat to the next drip window; a written statement cannot stand in.
